_comment: Copy this file to appsettings.Local.json (gitignored) and fill in machine-specific values. Loads after appsettings.json/appsettings.Development.json, so it overrides them. Holds machine-specific read-only DB, legacy asset and optional Data Protection paths. Never commit real connection strings. Every connection value in this example is a placeholder.
_LegacyAssets_comment: Absolute path to the legacy Content folder served at /Content (images/fonts/model CSS-JS). Machine-specific. macOS dev e.g. /Users/you/Project/GitClone/web24.05/Content ; Windows server e.g. C:\inetpub\szaipa\Content (use doubled backslashes in JSON) or the path to a web24.05\Content copy. Leave empty to skip serving legacy assets.
_DataProtection_comment: Development may leave KeysPath empty and use App_Data/DataProtection-Keys under the project. To test release-style persistence, set an absolute path outside the project/release root. ApplicationName must stay stable across releases.
_AdminWrite_comment: Staff/admin backend write path. Off by default. TWO ways to enable: (A) LOCAL READ-ONLY INSPECTION (recommended for local debug — log in and browse, no writes): set EnableWrites=true + UseReadOnlyConnectionForDebug=true and DON'T set ConnectionStrings:SzaipaAdmin; the admin context then reuses the read-only LegacyData:Szaipa connection (db_datareader), so login/dashboard/list work but any save fails at the SQL level. (B) REAL WRITES (release/deploy only): set EnableWrites=true and point ConnectionStrings:SzaipaAdmin at a LOCAL WRITABLE COPY (never production, never prod creds, never committed).
_DebugLogin_comment: When UseReadOnlyConnectionForDebug=true a fixed local-debug account is enabled so you can sign in to inspect the backend WITHOUT a real Staff row (works even if the read-only DB is unreachable). Defaults: username 'debug', password 'debug'. Override with DebugUserName/DebugPassword. NEVER enable UseReadOnlyConnectionForDebug in committed/production config — it would expose this login.
_TongouAdminWrite_comment: Tongou(同构) admin write path, same two options as AdminWrite above. For local read-only inspection set EnableWrites=true + UseReadOnlyConnectionForDebug=true (reuses the read-only LegacyData:Tongou connection); for real writes point ConnectionStrings:TongouAdmin at a local writable copy.
_ConnectionStrings_comment: Only needed for option (B) real writes against local disposable copies. Every field below is a placeholder; never replace it in this tracked example.
